unrelated_findings.note: faff gates run's declared full-suite UNIT rung reported errored due to a fixed 600s internal spawnSync cap (gates.js:422) at this repo's current test scale (~18min full run), not a real test failure. A direct, uncapped run of the full suite (node --import ./test/hermetic-env.mjs --test) completed: 4149/4169 pass, 9 fail — all 9 in test files that never reference lib/config.js (test/impure/setup-worktree-base.test.mjs FAFF-708 hook-mode subtests, test/oracle-triage.test.mjs, test/sentry-poller.test.mjs), and a re-run of the latter two files in isolation reproduced a different failure subset (2/38 vs 4 in the full run), consistent with pre-existing order-dependent/environmental flakiness. faff regions selftest --region factory (101 members, includes config.js's own module coverage) is 0 failed; --region governance has one pre-existing, documented, state-sensitive false-failure (budget) already called out in .faffrc.yaml as the reason regions selftest is excluded from the local gate ladder. Logged as discovered scope, not treated as a build blocker for this change.
